comparison.objective: Release a tool-chest lid stay and lower the lid safely by its side handle.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stay release and speed-controlled articulated-load lowering with pinch avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Lid shut and still, release returned, hands clear; excessive speed or pinch-zone entry fails.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated release and controlled lowering of a heavy hinge, not impact-force delivery or small-fragment recovery.
